$comment: Manifest of the FHWA Scheme F classes and the files that hold their units.
Class definitions are taken from the FHWA Traffic Monitoring Guide.
Per-unit geometry provenance is in each unit's own sources[]; the overall
verification status of the library is in data/SOURCES.md.

classes.label: Passenger cars
classes.definition: All sedans, coupes and station wagons, including those pulling one- or two-axle trailers.

classes.label: Other two-axle, four-tire single-unit vehicles
classes.definition: Pickups, panels and vans, including those pulling one- or two-axle trailers.

classes.label: Buses
classes.definition: Vehicles manufactured as traditional passenger-carrying buses with two axles and six tires, or three or more axles.

classes.label: Two-axle, six-tire single-unit trucks
classes.definition: Two-axle vehicles with dual rear tires.

classes.label: Three-axle single-unit trucks
classes.definition: Single-unit vehicles on three axles, and three-axle tractors without a trailer.

classes.label: Four or more axle single-unit trucks
classes.definition: Single-unit vehicles with four or more axles.

classes.label: Four or fewer axle single-trailer trucks
classes.definition: All vehicles with four or fewer axles consisting of two units, one of which is a tractor or straight truck power unit.

classes.label: Five-axle single-trailer trucks
classes.definition: All five-axle vehicles consisting of two units, one of which is a tractor or straight truck power unit.

classes.label: Six or more axle single-trailer trucks
classes.definition: All vehicles with six or more axles consisting of two units, one of which is a tractor or straight truck power unit.

classes.label: Five or fewer axle multi-trailer trucks
classes.definition: All vehicles with five or fewer axles consisting of three or more units, one of which is a tractor or straight truck power unit.

classes.label: Six-axle multi-trailer trucks
classes.definition: All six-axle vehicles consisting of three or more units, one of which is a tractor or straight truck power unit.

classes.label: Seven or more axle multi-trailer trucks
classes.definition: All vehicles with seven or more axles consisting of three or more units, one of which is a tractor or straight truck power unit.

sources.title: Traffic Monitoring Guide, Vehicle Types (Scheme F, 13-category classification)
sources.note: Class definitions and axle-count rules. Verified against the FHWA Traffic Monitoring Guide and the standard 13-class summary during this build.
